title: Gateway ping and sensor telemetry compatibility hardening
acceptance_criteria: Gateway summary retries probe via generate when show ping is rejected as invalid command.
Gateway summary still parses RTT/RTTsd/Loss across varied ping output formats.
System dashboard summary reads CPU temperature from sensors even when show sensors is unsupported.
Regression tests exist for show->generate fallback on ping and sensors.
Runtime smoke checks pass after backend restart.
assumptions: Some VyOS builds reject op-mode ping under show but allow it via generate.
Some VyOS builds expose sensors output via generate path only.
Unrelated dirty files in the working tree are pre-existing and out of scope for this hotfix.

tasks.notes: Added show->generate fallback paths for gateway ping and dashboard sensors acquisition.
Added regressions for invalid show ping fallback and invalid show sensors fallback.
Manual review completed; changes are additive and preserve API contracts.

commands.test: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_gateway_summary.py tests/test_system_dashboard_temperature.py tests/test_system_lldp_parsing.py tests/test_safe_apply.py
